description: This file defines a generic class BufferGrain<T> implementing buffer-like behavior for message passing in a distributed system, with methods for sending, receiving, and linking messages, but most methods are not yet implemented.

classes.name: BufferGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic buffer class for message handling in a distributed dataflow system, supporting message offering, sending, linking, and receiving.

methods.name: OfferMessage
methods.description: Intended to offer a message to the buffer, with optional consumption, but not yet implemented.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Adds a message to the internal list asynchronously.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method to send a message with a cancellation token, not yet implemented.

methods.name: LinkTo
methods.description: Links this buffer to a target grain, not yet implemented.

methods.name: ConsumeMessage
methods.description: Consumes a message from the buffer, not yet implemented.

methods.name: ReceiveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all buffered messages and clears the buffer.
